description:
The tracked wallets holding a token, sorted by balance, with market cap and
    price in USD on Solana. Use when the user asks who is still holding, rather
    than who ever traded it.

    blockchain: solana, bnb, base, eth or rh
    mint: token address
    wallet_type: restrict to kol, smart or whale. Omit to merge all types.
    limit: how many holders (default 25)

blockchain.description: Blockchain. One of: solana, bnb, base, eth, rh. solana has kol, smart and whale wallets; bnb, base and rh have kol and smart; eth has kol only. rh is Robinhood Chain, an Ethereum L2.
blockchain.title: Blockchain

limit.description: How many entries to return. Keep it small: large results are trimmed to fit the context window anyway.
limit.title: Limit

mint.description: Token address: the mint on Solana, the contract address on the EVM chains.
mint.title: Mint

wallet_type.description: Restrict to one wallet type: kol, smart or whale. Leave empty to merge all types the chain has.
wallet_type.title: Wallet Type

name: get_token_holders
